summary: This experimental document specifies TCP-Friendly Multicast Congestion Control, a single-rate scheme for multicast in best-effort networks. The sender adapts to the receiver seeing the worst conditions. It competes reasonably fairly with TCP and keeps a smooth rate, which suits streaming media.

eli5.summary: When one speaker talks to a whole room, they must slow down for the person who has the most trouble hearing. This way the speaker is polite to everyone else using the room.
